prototypePlanFromParent.countingCaveat: Two inference prototypes do not satisfy a 10000-system request. Frozen HMM decision control is formally equivalent to ETH buy-and-hold after warmup; only BOCPD adds a nonbaseline fitted policy. Both failed the exploratory profitability screen.
prototypePlanFromParent.hmmRedundancyProof: Fourteen-day expected log growth is linear in the filtered posterior. All three pure-state forecasts exceed the entry hurdle, so every posterior mixture targets long. All 16 study window/scenario ledgers equal ETH buy-and-hold.
prototypePlanFromParent.bocpdOutcome: Selected because development is zero-trade cash while HMM loses; later-2025 and continuous net lose, recent-2026 has no trades.
